jobs.description:
**The Impact You'll Make

**At Danfoss Climate Solutions, we engineer energy-efficient heating and cooling solutions that help our customers decarbonize while staying resilient and competitive. Our Controls and Thermal Management division combines heat exchanger expertise with technologies for refrigeration, cooling and air conditioning, serving customers across HVAC, refrigeration and industrial applications.

In this role, you’ll lead our European Sales team for Brazed, Gasketed and Welded Heat Exchangers and play a key role in accelerating growth across both existing customers and new markets.

Your impact? You’ll shape and execute our European sales strategy, strengthen how we go to market, and continue the transformation toward a modern, data-driven sales organization with customer experience at its core.

Working closely with regional and global stakeholders, you’ll combine commercial leadership, market insights and strong customer engagement to turn opportunities into sustainable business growth.

We would prefer you to be located close to one of our main hubs in Kolding, Denmark, Kamnik, Slovenia, or Hamburg, Germany. Remote work may be considered for the right candidate, and we are open to supporting relocation.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Lead, develop and empower a European team of technical sales engineers and business developers to deliver sustainable sales growth.

• Shape and execute sales plans based on market insights, customer buying behavior and business priorities, working closely with regional and global stakeholders.

• Develop existing accounts and turn new leads, markets and customer opportunities into business growth.

• Build strong customer relationships through regular market engagement, identifying customer needs and demonstrating the value of our products and solutions.

• Drive a disciplined, data-driven sales approach through consistent use of CRM, forecasting and sales processes to support agile decision-making.

**What We're Looking For

**

• A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or equivalent knowledge and experience, combined with significant experience in sales, engineering or business development.

• Strong commercial and strategic capabilities, with the ability to analyze markets, competitors and opportunities and translate insights into effective business strategies.

• Strong negotiation, communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage customers, partners and diverse internal stakeholders.

• Knowledge of HVAC and/or industrial applications and markets, supported by solid analytical capabilities.

• A flexible and resourceful approach to changing market conditions, with the ability to navigate challenges and identify opportunities for growth.

The role requires approximately 20–40% travel, primarily within Europe.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about. We think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.occupation: Senior Frontend Engineer - with an interest in fullstack
jobs.description:
About Cardlay
Cardlay is a Danish fintech building white-label card and spend management solutions. Banks, issuers and financial partners in Europe and the US offer our platform to their business customers using their own brand.

We are a small dedicated team with short decision paths. We make bold decisions, turn them into results by helping each other, and give people the mandate to own what they build.
About the job
Our web portal is where companies run their spend: cards, expenses, accounting and people management. Every bank offers it under its own brand.

Some of the core capabilities include

• Cards: card programs, card orders and requests, and funding accounts
• Expenses: transactions, receipts, mileages and expense policies
• Accounting: categories, cost dimensions, GL accounts and exports to external accounting systems
• People and teams: onboarding, invitations, roles and company settings
Under the hood, it's React, TypeScript, pnpm workspaces and Vite.

Every new bank brings its own brand and requirements, and AI agents now write a growing share of our code. We need a senior engineer who builds the product and keeps the shared components and patterns behind them consistent, so new screens, whether built by people or AI agents, look and work like the rest of the product.

This is a hands-on product role with significant ownership: you will build features every day and help set our frontend direction.

What success looks like after a year

• Customers use features you built and shipped end to end
• A new feature takes less code and fewer review rounds than it does today
• New screens are built from shared components by default, by people and AI agents alike
• The core libraries are up to date with latest security updates and we are on a clear upgrade path going forward
The challenge

Customers rely on the platform every day, and it has grown over several years:

• Some pages use our new design system and some don't yet. Deciding what to migrate, and when, to keep the experience consistent is ongoing work
• You work closely with our UI/UX Lead. That takes the confidence to push back on designs that hurt the user experience, and the taste to know when you're right
• There are several ways of handling data and state in the codebase, and picking the right one for each case directly affects what customers experience
• We're a small team, and other developers contribute a lot to the web portal. As the senior frontend engineer, you decide what's good enough to merge and where our code style and stack go next
• You look beyond your own domain. When the answer is on the other side of the API, you read the backend code and unblock yourself where you canWhat you'll do
As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will own the frontend of our web portal. You take responsibility for what we ship, make decisions others can build on, drive projects forward and help the people around you grow.

You will be the primary frontend engineer in an engineering team of 10 people across frontend, backend, mobile and DevOps. You will work closely with Product and our UI/UX Lead, and report to our Head of Engineering.

Your responsibilities will include

• Take responsibility for the frontend as a whole: its quality, performance and direction
• Make the key frontend decisions and stand by them: architecture, what goes into the design system and when to say no
• Drive projects from idea to production with Product and our UI/UX Lead, and own them until customers are using them
• Build reusable components and patterns as part of your product work, not one-off solutions
• Move legacy screens onto the design system as you work on them, without silent visual regressions
• Set up component APIs, lint rules and docs so AI agents produce code that fits
• Mentor other engineers and share what you know through reviews, docs and pairingWho you are
We are looking for an experienced frontend engineer who loves building a product and cares about the quality and consistency behind it.

You likely bring

• Deep experience with React and TypeScript
• You have shipped complex features in a web product that customers rely on
• You use AI coding tools every day and know where they go wrong
• A good eye for UX and product quality
• You speak up when something could be done better, and you see your work through to production
• You have driven projects with other engineers and helped them grow through mentoring and reviews
Bonus if you have

• Experience building component libraries or design systems
• Design tokens or white-label theming
• Interest in fullstack work, so you can help out on the backend when you can
• Experience from fintech or complex B2B products
You will work with the technologies below. We don't expect experience with all of them; we are looking for engineers who learn quickly.

• React, TypeScript
• Vite, pnpm workspaces, Biome
• MUI, styled-components, Storybook
• TanStack Query, TanStack Table, Redux Toolkit
• React Hook Form, react-intl
• Vitest, MSW, CypressWhy Cardlay
You will join at a point where our platform is proven, our customer base is growing and AI is changing how we build software. You will have a real say in how Cardlay builds the frontend, in a team where senior engineers set the direction.

• Permanent employment, freelance or consultancy, with salary or rate matching experience
• Hybrid work from our offices in Copenhagen or Odense
• English as our main working language, with Danish spoken too. You don't need to speak Danish to join
• Flexible working hours, and the option to work from home when it suits you and the team
• Company-paid phone and home internet
• Lunch, coffee, fruit, drinks and snacks at the officeHow to apply
Go ahead and hit "apply" and upload your résumé, application and other relevant information through our HR system.

Any questions about the position can be directed to our Head of Engineering:

Magnus Biolzi Hansen, Mail: mbh@cardlay.com, Telephone: +45 42 28 62 42

Application deadline: We review applications as they come in and will close the position once we've found the right person.

This is your opportunity to join an international group on an exciting transformation journey and play a key role in shaping the tax agenda at operational level.

We are looking for a Direct Tax Manager to join our Global Tax team. You will report directly to the Head of Global Tax and become part of a highly skilled team of colleagues covering Direct Tax, Transfer Pricing and Indirect Tax.

You are most likely a technically strong tax professional with a hands on approach. You will have a broad operational responsibility with a strong focus on Danish corporate income tax within a joint taxation group, Direct Tax across the group and an interest in tax digitalisation.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As Tax Manager, you will work closely with the Head of Global Tax, other team members and internal stakeholders across finance and the business. Your main responsibilities will include:

• Responsibility for Danish corporate income tax compliance, including joint taxation (sambeskatning)

• Preparation and review of tax calculations and tax returns

• Participation in dialogue with tax authorities, including audits and enquiries

• Monitoring tax legislation and assessing impacts on the group

• Contributing to process optimisation, automation, digitalisation and development of tax governance

• Acting as a sparring partner to finance functions and other stakeholders in the organisation

• Contribution to transfer pricing compliance and documentation

• Contribution to Pillar Two compliance

The role combines technical depth with practical execution, and you will have significant exposure to both national and international tax matters.

Your profile

We are looking for a strong tax professional who thrives in a collaborative environment.

You Likely Have

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree within Tax, Accounting, Finance or a related field

• Solid experience with Danish corporate income tax, including joint taxation

• Experience with tax reconciliations, including reconciliation between tax calculations, tax reporting and financial accounts

• Knowledge of cooperative taxation (andelsbeskatning) is considered an advantage

• Experience working with multinational organisations and shared service centers is considered an advantage

• A structured and analytical mindset with attention to detail

• The ability to work independently while being a strong team player

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex tax matters clearly

• Fluent in Danish and English (written and spoken).

The team and working environment

You will join a dedicated Global Tax team with high professional standards and a pragmatic, solution oriented mindset. We work closely together across tax disciplines and value trust, openness and knowledge sharing.

The position is based at our office in Randers, offering flexible working conditions.

Why join us?

We offer an exciting and visible role in a complex international group undergoing transformation.

You Will Have The Opportunity To

• Work with a broad tax scope and real business impact

• Develop your technical and professional skills in close collaboration with experienced colleagues

• Being part of a company that values trust, openness and personal development

• Enjoy attractive employment conditions, including a competitive salary, pension and health insurance

Interested?

If you are motivated by responsibility, complexity and collaboration, we would be pleased to hear from you. If you have any questions about the role, please contact Director, Head of Global Tax, Merete Rousing Glob at +45 41 15 55 10.

Please submit your application and CV as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Senior Manager, Software Cyber Security

• Full-time

Job Description

Would you like to work with Cyber Security for Industrial Systems in a company that develops and maintains highly complex, mission critical systems for a global market? Then take this opportunity to create something that matters.

Join us to apply your expertise within Cyber Security of complex software products and projects for logistics centres and airports worldwide. Take on this exciting and demanding leadership challenge to help us deliver integrated Cyber Security for vital infrastructure solutions.

Join a software center of excellence

You join BEUMER Group to become responsible for our Cyber Security activities for our portfolio of technically complex software products and projects for automated baggage handling systems and parcel sorters. These mission critical systems are installed across international airports and logistics centers as a completely essential part of daily operations 24/7/365. We have the leading products on the market, and the office in Aarhus, Denmark, is an international center of excellence within the BEUMER organization.

Cyber Security for industrial systems

Specifically, you become responsible for monitoring and implementing best practices within Cyber Security for industrial systems. Focus is on Cyber Security for the systems that we deliver to our customers. We comply with internationally recognized standards and have a process-oriented approach as Cyber Security is part of all aspects of what we do.

You will have a close dialogue with both our software product organization and our software project organization and our project IT-Infrastructure team. You will quite naturally be working closely with our Software Process Improvement department, and you will report to the Global Software Director.

Leader of a specialist team

You will be leading a small team of highly professional cyber security specialists while at the same time driving cyber security across BEUMERs global software team in close collaboration with BEUEMRs CISO team. As such you will be in dialog with group companies and product and project departments coordinating cyber security initiatives and communicating Cyber Security strategy, roadmap and best practices.

Skilled in Cyber Security

As responsible for our Cyber Security activities, your task is to enable the organization to deliver Cyber Secure software products, projects and services needed for mission critical systems. To do so, we believe you:

• Have a relevant master’s degree related to software development and/or cyber security

• Experience in analyzing a software organization's cybersecurity priorities and practices

• You have at least 2 years’ of relevant experience in the cybersecurity field.

• Previous work experience with applying or using frameworks such as ISA/IEC 62443, EU CRA, NIS2 and ISO27001/2 in an international environment.

• Relevant security certifications (CISSP, CCSK etc.) are a plus

Other than that, we would also like you to:

• Be structured, factual and have well-developed analytical and problem-solving skills with practical ability to shape the Cybersecurity agenda.

• Thrive in a fast-paced international environment with many stakeholders

• Have a good understanding of technologies and methodologies within software development

• Possess solid leadership skills and strong in stakeholder management and communication knowing how to create buy-in and setting direction.

• Have knowledge about agile software development processes, CMMI and similar methods and standards would be an advantage.

• Be PMI, IPMA or Prince2 certified or similar training/certification would be a plus.

Some travel must be expected as we are an international organisation. Therefore we expect you to communicate fluently in English.

To lead our cyber security activities, you will in addition to the above need drive, energy, and good commutation and stakeholder management skills. You have the experience to facilitate improvement initiatives and implement changes in an organization.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding this position, please do not hesitate to contact Talent Acquisition Lead Søren Elkjær Holm on +45 3176 0448.

BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletizing, packing, serration and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all of our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

jobs.occupation: Would you like to combine your technical studies with practical experience and learn how industrial equipment is installed and commissioned?
jobs.description:
Intern for our On-site team – Spring 2027Would you like to combine your technical studies with practical experience and learn how industrial equipment is installed and commissioned?
At Gram Equipment, we develop and deliver equipment for industrial ice cream production worldwide. We are looking for a Marine and Technical Engineering student (maskinmester) or a student from a similar technical programme to join our On-site team in Kolding for an internship in spring 2027.

You will work alongside experienced colleagues and gain insight into how we prepare and coordinate installation and commissioning activities at customer sites. Along the way, you will learn how technical requirements, planning and collaboration across departments contribute to getting equipment ready for production.
What you will be doing
You will support our On-site team in their daily work, with tasks adapted to your skills, interests and study requirements. Your tasks may include:

• Supporting the planning and preparation of installation and commissioning activities.
• Preparing and updating technical documentation, checklists and progress reports.
• Participating in coordination meetings and following up on agreed actions.
• Helping coordinate activities across On-site, Project Management, Engineering and Service.
• Supporting the follow-up on technical questions and outstanding issues.
• Collecting feedback from installation projects and contributing ideas to improve processes and ways of working.
As you develop your understanding of our equipment and working methods, you will have the opportunity to take responsibility for defined tasks with guidance from the team.
Who we are looking for
You are studying Marine and Technical Engineering (maskinmester), Mechanical Engineering or a related technical programme. You have an interest in industrial equipment and are curious about how mechanical, electrical and automation systems work together in practice.

We also imagine that you:

• Are eager to apply your technical knowledge and learn from experienced colleagues.
• Work in a structured way and follow through on your tasks.
• Enjoy collaborating with people across different functions.
• Take initiative and ask questions when you need input.
• Communicate clearly in English, both spoken and written.
You do not need previous experience with installation or commissioning. What matters is your willingness to learn and contribute.
What we offer
You will gain practical experience in an international engineering company, with support and feedback from experienced colleagues. You will work on tasks connected to real projects and develop your technical understanding and coordination skills.

Our main office in Kolding offers an informal working environment with dedicated colleagues.

The internship will take place in spring 2027. We will agree on the start date, duration, scope and learning objectives in line with your study programme.

The internship will also involve travel to customer sites, giving you the opportunity to experience installation and commissioning activities first-hand alongside experienced colleagues.
Interested?
Please send your CV and a short application explaining your motivation. Include your preferred internship period and any requirements from your study programme.

For questions about the internship, please contact Andreas Haldrup at APH@gram-equipment.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

Production Planning & Supply Chain Coordinator

(m/f/d)

As a Production Planning & Supply Chain Coordinator (m/f/d) you will do the following:

Production planning

Draw up and monitor production plans

Develop capacity and resource plans including checking the availability of materials

Plan and coordinate production orders

Track production performance and proactively implement corrective actions in cases of deviation

Work closely with production, design and materials management

Compile key performance indicators and produce regular reports based on production data

Purchasing and Supplier Management

Create and process purchase orders and associated documents in BC

Obtain and verify order confirmations and monitor delivery times

Obtain quotations, compare prices and identify opportunities for cost savings

Optimise costs and procurement processes

Build and maintain professional relationships with suppliers

Data and process improvement

Ensure accurate and up-to-date master data in BC, e.g. products and suppliers

Improve workflows within planning and procurement

Contribute to new standards and continuous improvements across production and procurement

What you bring with you

You have a commercial or technical qualification, for example as an industrial technician, technical assistant, procurement officer or similar.

Experience in production planning, procurement or materials management within a manufacturing company is an advantage.

You have practical experience with EPR systems, preferably Microsoft Business Central and are keen to work actively with the system.

It is a plus if you have:

• Experience in production planning or procurement

• Strong Excel skills for data management, analysis and reporting

• Experience with key performance indicators and operational reporting

• Knowledge of Lean or other process improvement methods

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in German is a plus.

You do not need to be an expert in all these areas from day one. The most important thing is that you have an interest in production and supply chains, work systematically and take responsibility for seeing tasks through to completion.

**You also

**

• Build positive working relationships through clear and professional communication

• Demonstrate a structured, reliable, and detail-oriented working style

• Take initiative, contribute proactively, and collaborate effectively with others

• Stay organised and adapt priorities when circumstances change

• Use analytical thinking to identify and drive process improvements

**We offer you

**

• A dynamic position where your decisions make a real impact on operations and customer delivery

• A collaborative and supportive team environment with colleagues across Denmark and Germany

• The freedom to drive improvements and influence how we work with Business Central

• The chance to be part of an international company helping make offshore wind safer and more reliable worldwide

Welcome to Sabik Offshore A/S

We have been mastering the art of metalworking since 1888. With over 130 years of experience, we are committed to innovation and delivering exceptional solutions for our customers and partners. Our skilled team of 20 employees specializes in crafting high-quality components and structures from sheet metal and tubes in steel, stainless steel, and aluminum.

Combining traditional craftsmanship with a focus on flexibility and quality, we pride ourselves on exceeding customer expectations.

Sabik Offshore A/S is looking for a structured and committed Production Planning & Supply Chain Coordinator. The role combines production planning and procurement, acting as the link between production, design, materials management and our suppliers.

You’ll report to production management and join a team of 5–8 colleagues in Vejle who work in Microsoft Business Central (BC). BC will be your primary tool, and you’ll play an active role in both its day-to-day use and its further development – working closely with BC users at Sabik Offshore in Glostrup and Schwerin.

Sabik Offshore A/S is an international company in the offshore industry. In Vejle, we manufacture metal structures, including railing systems for offshore wind farms.

As a Production Planner & Supply Chain Coordinator you will be working at the forefront of an industry of the future. Are you ready?

This is the way

to your future

If you would like further information or to submit your application,

please contact our HR Manager Wolfgang Schaper at +49 385 6767 0018 or jobs@sabik-offshore.com.

We look forward to hearing about you and your experience.

jobs.occupation: Senior Associate, Global Clinical Drug Supply Manufacturing
jobs.description:
We are extra[not]ordinary

*(ex· tra· not· or· di· nary |\ ik-ˈstr-not-ȯr-də-ˌner-ē)

Adjective: A unique word for Genmab meaning to go way beyond what is

usual; to be remarkable; proudly unique and authentic

Back to search results

Previous job Next job

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

Genmab is searching for an energized Senior Associate to be part of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing in Copenhagen within commute distance from our office locations to work according to your hybrid work arrangement.

With an impressive pipeline and many ongoing clinical trials, you will have a central role in supporting inspection readiness across our late-stage clinical development portfolio. Your work will help ensure that documentation is complete, compliant and readily available to support the successful execution of business-critical GMP and GCP inspections.

You will support inspection readiness activities within Global Clinical Supply, collecting, organizing and performing completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation. During inspections, you will participate in back-office activities and help ensure timely retrieval and follow-up of requested information.

The role also offers an opportunity to develop beyond inspection readiness. You will work closely with the Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing and support selected functional initiatives, providing exposure to broader activities across the organization and our CMO and vendor network. In parallel, you will have the opportunity to build your GMP and clinical supply knowledge by learning and supporting selected operational activities related to outsourced packaging and labelling of IMP and AxMP.

The position reports to the Director, Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing based in Copenhagen.

Responsibilities

• Support inspection readiness across late-stage clinical trials by collecting, organizing and maintaining relevant clinical supply documentation.

• Perform completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation against applicable procedures and inspection-readiness expectations.

• Participate in back-office activities during GMP and GCP inspections, including document retrieval, request coordination and tracking of responses and follow-up items.

• Support preparation for mock inspections, audits and health authority inspections, including compilation and review of supporting documentation for completeness and readiness.

• Support the Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing with selected functional initiatives and tasks across the organization.

• Support activities related to our external CMO and vendor network, including coordination, follow-up and preparation of relevant material and documentation.

• Build knowledge of GMP and clinical supply activities within Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing and learn and support selected operational tasks related to outsourced packaging and labelling of IMP and AxMP.

• Participate in maintenance and continuous improvement of procedures, tools and ways of working supporting inspection readiness and clinical supply activities.

• Responsible to be compliant with Genmab´s quality system.

Requirements

• Minimum a bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

• Some experience working with documentation, quality or compliance activities in the pharmaceutical, biotech, clinical research or another regulated environment is an advantage.

• Knowledge and understanding of GMP and GCP; experience with inspection or audit readiness is an advantage.

• Strong interest in documentation, quality and compliance, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work.

• Ability to coordinate activities, maintain structure and follow up on actions involving multiple stakeholders.

• Ability to work successfully under pressure in a fast-paced environment and with tight timelines, including during inspections.

• Ability to be proactive, enthusiastic, curious and goal orientated, with a willingness to learn new GMP-related activities.

• A team player with demonstrated ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including CMOs and vendors.

• Strong communication skills in English - both oral and written.

The Team

You will be part of a highly competent team focused on GMP applicable to packaging and labelling of supplies for clinical trials, with a strong focus on quality, inspection readiness and successful collaboration with our internal stakeholders and CMOs.

Together with Global Clinical Supply Portfolio & Project Delivery and Global Clinical Supply Systems, the teams make up the Global Clinical Supply department.

We have an international and informal working environment with a high pace, strong one-team spirit and close collaboration across functions.

Application

Has this sparked your interest? Then we encourage you to upload your CV and cover letter including your motivation for this position. We screen candidates on a continuous basis and call in for interviews.

Fully remote applicants will not be considered, so please indicate if you are willing to relocate if you’re not currently living in commute distance.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK544.000,00---816.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Job Description

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Responsibilities & technologies

In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.

• Structuring and collection of data from various sources.

• Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.

• Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.

• Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.

About you

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:

• ETL and Database technologies.

• Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.

• Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. jobs.occupation: Physiological & Sports Medicine Advisor - Elite Football
jobs.description:
At Twinspire, we're building a digital twin platform for individualised athlete modelling in elite football. We are already testing this live in clubs through ongoing pilot studies.

The question we care about is simple: can data-driven signals actually support decisions that practitioners trust?

The role

We're looking for a physiotherapist, sports medicine professional, or physician with experience in elite or semi-elite football. Not to validate what we're building, but to challenge it.

This is not a narrow return-to-play role. We're looking for someone who can connect:

• physiology

• data

• research

• and real-world decision-making

You understand that athlete management is not clean or protocol-driven, but contextual, uncertain, and often subjective. That's exactly the gap we're trying to close.

What you will do

You will work directly with the founding team and DTU research group.

You will:

• Pressure-test whether model outputs make sense physiologically

• Call out when signals don't translate to real decisions

• Help bridge the gap between research and applied practice

• Shape what a useful signal actually looks like in elite environments

• Push us to build something that holds up under scrutiny, not just in theory

What we are looking for

Someone who:

• Has worked closely with elite or semi-elite football players

• Brings strong physiological and/or sports medicine expertise

• Is comfortable questioning both data and established practice

• Has felt the gap between what's measured and what's actually useful

• Wants to be part of defining what better looks like

What we offer

• Direct involvement in a validation study with elite football clubs across the Nordics

• Opportunity for research co-authorship

• Equity participation

• A chance to shape how athlete modelling is applied in real environments

Employment Type

Full-time

Location

Copenhagen, Denmark

Department

Science

If this resonates, reach out: roxane@twinspire.ai

DTU · Copenhagen · www.twinspire.ai

Private markets are being transformed — and you could be at the center of it.

The gap between institutional grade private market tools and the technology that powers them has never been bigger. Trillions of dollars flow through private equity, venture capital, private credit, and real assets, yet the software managing this capital often lags a decade behind. SimCorp is changing that.

We're a fast-growing fintech company on a mission to modernize the private market ecosystem for institutional investors with cross-asset portfolios. We're scaling fast, our customers are the best in the world, and we're looking for a world-class Product Manager to help us build what comes next.

If you understand the nuances of Private Markets, have a deep empathy for the professionals navigating this space, and know how to turn complexity into elegant software, we need to talk.

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

As a key component of product management for Private Markets, you will own the product strategy and execution alongside our engineering team. You will sit at the intersection of finance and technology translating the intricate workflows of private market professionals into intuitive, powerful software that delights users and drives business outcomes.

This is a high-visibility, high-impact role. You'll work directly with the leadership, clients, market participants, engineering, sales and go-to-market teams, and you'll have real ownership over a product area that is central to our company's growth. You will shape the roadmap, define priorities, and rally a talented team of engineers and designers around a shared vision.

What You Will Be Responsible For

• Orchestrate high-stakes product demonstrations, executive roundtables, and client conferences to evangelize the solution and secure stakeholder buy-in across diverse audiences.

• Define, own and evolve the product roadmap for our private markets platform, balancing short-term customer needs with long-term strategic vision.

• Be the primary point of contact, the go-to person for private markets and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders.

• Strategically own, manage and prioritize the product backlog in lockstep with Leadership, balancing technical debt with high-value strategic investments to ensure seamless delivery.

• Deeply immerse yourself in the workflows of private markets - conducting interviews, shadowing users, and synthesizing feedback into actionable insights.

• Write crisp, well-reasoned product specifications and work hand-in-hand with engineering and design to ship high-quality features on time.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to author comprehensive user features and stories, establishing rigorous acceptance criteria to ensure all deliverables meet 'Definition of Ready' and 'Definition of Done' standards in the acceptance of deliverables.

• Define success metrics for every initiative and use data to evaluate outcomes, iterate quickly, and communicate results to stakeholders.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success to understand market gaps, competitive dynamics, and the evolving needs of our customer base.

• Identify and evaluate opportunities to integrate AI and automation into core workflows — making complex workflows faster, smarter, and more reliable.

• Drive alignment across cross-functional teams, ensuring clarity on priorities, tradeoffs, and the 'why' behind every decision.

• Stay ahead of regulatory developments, market trends, and competitive shifts in the private markets technology landscape.

• Represent the voice of the customer in every product decision — advocating relentlessly for user experience without sacrificing business viability.

Who You Are

You're not just a product manager, you're a private market expert who happens to love building software. You've spent time in or around private markets and you feel the pain points firsthand. You're the kind of person who gets genuinely excited when you see a workflow for the first time and immediately start mentally redesigning it. You are rigorous in your thinking, persuasive in your communication, and relentless in your follow-through.

You thrive in ambiguity. You can take a messy problem, break it down into its component parts, and build consensus around a path forward without needing every answer handed to you. You care about craft: a half-built feature or a confusing UX genuinely bothers you. And you're a collaborator at heart, you know that great products are built by great teams, and you know how to bring out the best in the people around you.

What We Value

• 5+ years product management experience, with at least 2 years in B2B SaaS or fintech.

• Meaningful exposure to private markets, whether through prior work at a PE firm, fund administrator, placement agent, LP, or financial software company serving these markets.

• Demonstrated track record of successfully launching products and features that users love and that drive measurable business results.

• Strong understanding of private asset structures, capital calls, distributions, investor reporting, and related workflows.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you can write a tight one-pager and present to a room of skeptical executives with equal confidence and are not afraid to use AI.

• Proficiency in working with data: you're comfortable analyzing usage metrics and building dashboards to support your decisions.

• Experience collaborating with engineering teams in an agile environment; familiarity with modern development practices is a plus.

• High EQ and the ability to build trust quickly with customers, engineers, and senior leadership alike.

• A genuine curiosity about technology and its role in reshaping financial services.

• Experience engaging proactively with clients and stakeholders to solicit input for user stories.

• Broad knowledge of the Alternative Investment marketplace and system vendors.

• Experience with SimCorp Dimension® (advantageous but not required).

• Proven track record in roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, Engineering, Business Analyst, Project Manager, or Consultant within software development.

• Strategic mindset with strong analytical skills focused on business outcomes and complete product offers.

• Ability to encourage, motivate, and influence teams and peers; contribute to improvements across the community.

• Understanding of how great products are built and deliver value to clients.

• Creative and inquisitive mindset with the ability to simplify complex concepts.

• Degree in Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Finance, or a related field (preferred).

Why Join Us

• Meaningful ownership — your decisions will shape a platform used by some of the world’s most sophisticated investors, and your work will have visible, lasting impact.

• A culture built on trust, autonomy, and deep collaboration.

• A leadership team with deep domain expertise, proven execution experience, and a genuine commitment to building an exceptional, humancentered culture.

• The opportunity to build category defining technology in a space undergoing massive transformation where your influence won’t just move the product forward, it will help reshape an entire industry.

• A place where craft matters, ideas win on merit, and people are encouraged to think boldly, act decisively, and do the best work of their careers.

NEXT STEPS

We welcome applications from new talents and new colleagues who want an exciting future in an international food group and are willing to help develop the company. Among other things, we are investing in increased automation so that our colleagues have the best possible platform for carrying out their daily tasks. Above all, we are a company of #butchers, #meatjobs, #diversity and #agoodplacetobe.

We are often looking for different employee categories. Knife experience and butchery skills would be an advantage, but we also need employees for packaging etc. . It is an advantage if you speak Danish or English, German or Polish, but not a requirement. You preferably have experience in the food industry.

We offer:

·        An exciting and challenging workplace with excellent conditions

·        Good, solid training

·        Dynamic collaboration with talented colleagues

·        Opportunities for professional and personal development

ü  An attractive salary package starting as soon as possible 💰 💰 💰 💰 💰 💰 💰 💰?

ü  Good colleagues 

We expect you to:

·        Be at least 18 years old

·        Have an efficient work style and thrive in an active and cheerful department

·        Be serious and stable in terms of attendance

You will be part of the existing team with a 37-hour working week in Brorup, or a 42,5 hour week in Thisted according to a local agreement.  The workplace is Markedsvej 9, 6650 Brørup, Denmark or Strandvejen 7, 7700 Thisted ,Denmark

Contact:

Please send your application by e-mail to job@tican.dk, subject  slaughterhouse operative “ Brørup” or “ Thisted “

Applications are assessed on an ongoing basis and positions will be filled as soon as we have found the right candidates.      

Tican Fresh Meat A/S is locally known beyond all borders. Read more on the website www.tican.dk.

How to Apply:

**Turn complexity into one plan the business can act on.

****What if planning could shape the future, not just react to it?

**Across the Nordics, demand is shaped by tenders, contracts, launches and changing customer needs. The opportunity is to bring those signals together early, translate them into clear choices and create a healthier balance between product availability and inventory. That is where you come in.

As our Demand & Supply Manager Nordics, you will create one reliable view of demand and supply across Denmark, Sweden, and Finland. You will own the Nordic Sales and Operations Planning cycle, lead a distributed planning team and help move the organization from reactive expediting towards confident, forward-looking decisions.

**Your impact

****Role

**This is not a role where you simply maintain a forecast. You will set the direction for how the Nordics plan, decide and improve. You will:

• Own one Nordic demand and supply plan, bringing tender and contract intelligence into the forecast early enough to influence decisions.

• Lead the full S&OP cycle, from portfolio and demand reviews through supply and management review, with clear monthly decisions and ownership.

• Take accountability for inventory health, availability and the working-capital effect of the plan, while preventing excess and risk stock from rebuilding.

• Lead and develop four planners and one analyst across Denmark, Sweden and Finland, creating one way of working that is resilient across countries and absences.

• Connect sales, category, tender, sourcing, finance, warehouse and transport around the same facts, priorities and actions.

**What Will Make You Successful

**You combine strong planning craft with practical leadership. You are comfortable moving between item-level detail and senior stakeholder decisions, and you know how to challenge constructively when the numbers tell a different story.

**You Are Likely To Bring

**

• 8-12 years in supply chain, including at least five years in demand and supply planning or S&OP.

• Experience owning a full S&OP or IBP cycle and leading a planning team, ideally across more than one country.

• Strong knowledge of inventory, working capital, forecast quality and excess or obsolete stock.

• Hands-on experience with an advanced planning system such as Slim4, o9, Kinaxis, SAP IBP or a comparable platform, plus strong Excel or BI skills.

• Professional English and, preferably, Danish or Swedish.

• A relevant Bachelor or Master degree. APICS, IBF or an equivalent certification is an advantage.

**The environment you will step into

**The scope is genuinely Nordic and the mandate is broad. You will have the space to shape the process while keeping the daily business moving.

You will work closely on standards, tools and the group excess and risk stock process. Your influence will reach well beyond your direct team, so trust, clarity and follow-through will matter as much as technical expertise.

**Ready to build what comes next?

**If you want to lead a cross-border team, create one Nordic planning approach and turn better demand and supply decisions into stronger service and healthier inventory, we would like to hear from you.

Location: Copenhagen Denmark or Kungsbacka Sweden. Travel: Regular travel within the Nordics and Europe is part of the role.

**Apply and help shape one Nordic view of demand and supply

**Submit your application through CareersatMediq.com or contact Artjoms.Bikovskis@Mediq.com, Talent Acquisition Partner Nordics and Baltics. We review every application with care and look forward to learning what you could bring to this next chapter of Nordic planning.

**About Mediq

**Mediq is a leading European healthcare company with a 125-year legacy, operating in 14 countries with over 3,000 employees. Guided by our vision to enable sustainable healthcare, we focus on improving care outcomes and affordability through innovative products, services, and solutions. Partnering with healthcare professionals across hospitals, clinics, and home care, we ensure patients receive the care they need to live independently, securely and feel more human.

At Mediq we offer jobs that change lives, join us.

The Siteimprove Search Insights team builds the tools our customers use to understand and improve how their content performs in search, both in classic search engines and in the AI assistants that increasingly answer questions on their behalf. We work at enterprise scale, with large volumes of crawled and third party search data, visibility and ranking analysis, and features that turn that data into recommendations marketers can act on.

We are also changing how we build. AI is part of every step, from requirements, to breaking work down, to implementing and reviewing it with coding agents. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who wants to build this way, and who helps us define the standard while we do it.

Tech stack you will be working with

• 
C# and .NET, TypeScript, React

• 
AWS, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes

• 
Event driven services and large scale data pipelines

• 
GitHub Actions for CI and CD

• 
Claude Code and other coding agents, MCP servers, Jira and Confluence as the working surface for the AI PDLC

What we will be doing

• 
Contribute to the technical direction of the team. Write the system designs for the work you own, take part in design reviews, and argue for the option you believe is right.

• 
Design and build systems yourself: services, APIs and data pipelines that stay stable, fast and affordable as data volumes grow.

• 
Lead our use of AI across the product development lifecycle. Take a product requirements document to a technical vision and system designs, break it into epics and user stories that an agent can act on, and set the standard at each step.

• 
Improve the scaffolding that makes agent driven delivery work: context and instruction files, prompts and skills, and the review and testing practice that keeps quality high when code arrives faster than before.

• 
Keep search data trustworthy, with tests, monitoring and errors a colleague can understand.

• 
Define how we measure quality, detect drift, and explain results to customers who make decisions based on them.

• 
Mentor engineers at all levels through design reviews, pairing and written technical proposals, including how to work well with agents.

• 
Treat cost, performance and operability as design inputs from the start.

• 
Take part in the daily work of the team: refinement, estimation, prototyping, debugging and production support.

• 
Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

• 
Perform other duties as assigned

What we will require of you

• 
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science.

• 
10 or more years of professional software development experience.

• 
5 or more years building and running services and APIs on a public cloud, preferably AWS.

• 
A track record of architecture decisions that span several teams, including the trade offs you rejected and why.

• 
You have owned features or services end to end, including what happened after they were released.

• 
Hands on experience using coding agents in real production work, with a clear view of where they help and where they do not.

• 
Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms and data structures, and a commitment to technical excellence.

• 
Excellent written and verbal English. You write proposals and designs that other people, and agents, can act on without a meeting.

• 
Willingness to work across the stack when the problem calls for it.

What we will love about you

• 
Experience turning product requirements into technical designs and a delivery plan that a team can execute.

• 
Experience with search, SEO, crawling, indexing, ranking or web scale data.

• 
Experience with infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

• 
Experience working in a team distributed across Europe and North America.

• 
You take pride in the work of the team and lead by example.

• 
You are comfortable replacing what you built yesterday with something better today.

What you'll love about usWe’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

In addition, we hope you will appreciate:

At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our Denmark benefits are designed to help you thrive personally and professionally.

Rest and relaxation: Generous time off including Danish holiday entitlements, five additional FF Days, child sick leave, and bereavement leave.

Comprehensive benefits: Health insurance, company-paid mobile phone support, and internet allowance to support your day-to-day needs.

Are you passionate about Linux and business-critical application operations? If so, you have the opportunity to play a key role in operating some of Denmark’s most business- and society-critical solutions. We are looking for an Operations Engineer to join Netcompany Operations, with solid Linux expertise.

Responsibilities and technologies

Netcompany Operations is a well-established operations organization responsible for everything from business- and mission-critical application operations to infrastructure management across two modern data centers and public cloud environments.

Our customer portfolio is highly diverse, ranging from small private companies to large-scale public sector projects. We approach operations with a clear vision: to make a meaningful difference to our customers’ businesses, and we expect you to share that ambition.

You will become part of a team focused on the optimization and operation of large, complex Enterprise Linux environments. From day one, you will be given significant responsibility and influence, playing a central role in designing, implementing, and optimizing both current and future solutions while maintaining direct contact with our customers.

As an experienced Operations Engineer, your responsibilites will typically include:

• Building and maintaining Linux-based environments and applications.

• Ensuring quality, optimization, and automation across environments and applications.

• Participating in ongoing operations projects, including major implementation and transition initiatives.

• Prioritizing and following up on customer requests within your area of responsibility.

About you

You are structured, detail-oriented, and highly accountable. You take full ownership of your work, have a strong service mindset, and understand the importance of supporting business objectives in a positive and constructive manner. In short, you are motivated by making a real impact.

To succeed in this role, we expect you to:

• Hold a degree in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field (bachelor’s, master’s, or equivalent).

• Have several years of experience from a a similar role.

• Are motivated by delivering optimal business- and mission-critical solutions.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

We encourage you to apply even if your educational background differs from the above, provided you have relevant qualifications and/or professional experience from a similar position.

Employment is contingent upon your ability to obtain and maintain security clearance from the Danish Security and Intelligence Service (PET).

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Partaking alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

Send us an application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit.
